lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's special Town Council hearing on the Carhenge lot subdivision appeal — someone challenged P&Z's unanimous approval of consolidating those parcels at 700 W. Pacific, and Council now has to sort it out before any redevelopment can move forward. That same day, HARC holds its own special meeting to dig into the Carhenge redevelopment itself, reviewing three separate preliminary applications for the proposed new construction there. Meanwhile, the Gondola Leadership Committee faces a real decision point Sunday on whether to pursue federal funding or go the local-control route — a choice with long-term consequences for how that infrastructure gets built and managed.

notable.stake: Council must choose federal funding vs. local control for gondola project delivery.
